title: ModelLifecycleReply
description: The operator's answer to a ModelLifecycleRequest, sent when the provider reports the model in the state asked for, not when the request was accepted.

ok.description: Whether the provider reports the model in the state asked for.

state.description: The model's state the provider last reported.

switchMs.description: How long making the model ready took, in milliseconds; 0 when it was already awake or the request was a release.

error.description: Why the request failed, when ok is false.
